class.name: RosService
class.brief_description: A ROS 2 Service Server for handling requests from service clients.
class.description: [RosService] allows Godot to act as a server for ROS 2 services. It is created through [method RosNode.create_service]. When a client sends a request to the service, the callback provided during creation is triggered. The callback signature should be: [code]func my_service_callback(request: RosMsg, response: RosMsg):[/code]. The [code]request[/code] argument contains the incoming data, and the [code]response[/code] argument is an empty message that should be populated by the callback before it returns. The service remains active as long as this object is not freed.
